text_block_list.text:
Our group homework sessions have become a regular thing
since then. Today, after finishing our work, we were all
taking a breather when—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: And so, it seems a lot of people cherish the class T-shirts they made back in school even after becoming adults. Many of the community members said so too—

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Making merch like that is so fun, isn't it?
Seems like there are more and more services nowadays where individuals can order custom goods, too."
choice_data_list: A handmade T-shirt, huh~ Now that's what youth is all about.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, don't you want to make team T-shirts for us too?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: ""! As in, 'DREAMS'?!""
choice_data_list: I like the sound of that!

text_block_list.text:
If we can sell it to fans, it'll serve as great PR, too.
It might provide a tailwind against all the skepticism surrounding our Breeders' Cup challenge.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "If it's design sketches, I can draw them~!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Doesn't that sound fun!
We can all brainstorm the design, and Maru-chan can draw it—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "—Huh? What did you say we're doing?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Team T? The hell is that? Cut it out with that cutesy, playing-friends vibe...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't that sound like fun?
Plus, if we sell them to the fans,
we can bring even more attention to our challenge!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I pour the spirit of 'I'm totally gonna conquer the BC~!' into this T-shirt!
And then, bam, you show it off with a punch!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm... well... I guess?
If that's what you mean, it might be worth doing...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Oh yeah, this might be a great chance...!
We gotta teach those folks who still doubt our strength
a lesson once and for all!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right?
So let's all make it together!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: So for the logo, we'll put the team name, along with some English text saying we're taking on the BC...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "I wanna choose what kind of font and vibe we use too~!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
A cool style is definitely the way to go!
The team name's gotta be massive, too!
The colors should stand out—how about black and gold?!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "‘White lettering with a gold trim might look super cool!’"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice! Why don't we put
the team members' names on it in small print, too?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: It's done...!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! That's crazy cool! You've got some serious skills, Marche!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"It's all thanks to your ideas, Espo-san~!
Your suggestions for the colors and fonts had such
great style... it really got my brush moving♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! It's a design that really gets your hopes up for conquering the Breeders' Cup—like charging into America and blowing them all away!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san really is
so incredibly kind, with such great taste...
She's a wonderful senior♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...!! It's not like I'm being nice or anything!
It's more like, I just wanna show everyone what's what!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, anyway, looks like we might make
a pretty kickass T-shirt, don'tcha think?!
We're gonna blow those fans away!

Later on, the finished T-shirts received a flood
of orders from fans! Wearing them during team training
brought us all a deeper sense of unity!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I'm ho~me...
Oh? What's going on? Looks like things are getting lively in here.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Sounds awesome! That's so emo, Team T!
For now, should we pick out some decent merch-making companies?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
And gotta secure distribution channels too.
Oh, maybe I should just brainstorm designs right now!!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "And the logo looks like this~"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice.
Oh, don't you want to add some illustrations too?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"I bet a dog like the one Loves drew before
would be super cute, y'know~♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Eh, that one?
But after we went through the trouble of getting team T-shirts...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
N-Nah, that's what Team T is all about, right?
Don't we wanna pack in every single bit of our individuality?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Marche designed the base logo, right~?
And Loves's master artist illustration is the trademark!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
How 'bout you pick the colors and motifs with your sense, <chrname>?
And I'll handle the decorating♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's individuality...
Yeah, that truly is wonderful Love, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All right, then...
I'm gonna draw the very best doggy...!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go grab some nail stones and glitter!
It's way easier to imagine if we have the real thing!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Alright, then I'll try sketching out a few more logo designs!"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
It's done—!!
Omg, isn't this super cute?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"My dog-like thing is all sparkly with glitter...!
I kinda feel like it's actually cute now...!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"One of the companies Yanko-san picked out
can do glitter finishes.
So we're all set!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: It's really so cute...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hhhmmm...
This is definitely gonna go viral!!

Just as planned... the finished team T-shirts went viral.
Going forward, "DREAMS" will become even more exciting,
and our team's unity will surely grow stronger!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I have returned.
...Oh my. Is something the matter, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A team T-shirt... and logo...
This must be... destiny...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Destiny?
Is there... something going on?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Actually, I was just—
thinking about a team emblem.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "‘Emblem...!? What... is that...?!’"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"A Saint is someone...
who goes on pilgrimages and embarks on adventures across the land
all to save the world, or for the sake of peace."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"And what matters most then are
trusted companions. Sharing a common destiny—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "We, 'DREAMS'—yes, we are a party traveling together toward the trial we must conquer: claiming victory in the BC."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Unshakeable unity is essential for our journey.
That's why I'm making an emblem to symbolize our party...!!
choice_data_list: (Desire's world is in full swing, huh...)

text_block_list.text:
Worrying if everything was all right,
I looked over at Loves Only You and the others...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "So, um... what is this crest?!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I did my absolute best
to make it in my own way. —Here it is.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
""T-This is...!
Is that motif in the center the profile of a praying saint...!?
How lovely... Is this Desire-san?""

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The font for the word "DREAMS"
is somehow so divine... and stylish!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
――Ah.
This circular part surrounding the whole thing is...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's a heart motif. Loves-san... it was made in your image, you see.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, the saint's hair has a motif too!
Hey, hey, these wings and musical notes...
Are they from Maru-chan's racing outfit hat decoration??"

Looking closely, throughout the piece...
there were motifs scattered all over, symbolizing
every single member of the team.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"We share a common destiny.
Let us join hands and overcome this trial together."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes!
Saintly Party, onward to the BC! Right?♪

The completed T-shirt became a hot topic thanks to its mystical design.
Let's keep this momentum going to hype up the BC and deepen our unity!
